ambient_events: The smokehouse ticks as its firebox settles.
Cold rolls out from under the walk-in door and dies at your ankles.
A chain on the rail clinks against the wall and goes still.
description: The back room, and the working half of the building. One wall is the walk-in, its door a slab of insulated steel with a handle worn to bare metal; the other is the smokehouse, a black cabinet the height of a person breathing a thin blue thread from a vent near the roof. Between them stands the block, end-grain, dished in the centre by a lifetime of the same three cuts. The wood chips live in a bin underneath. It's very cold and it smells wonderful.
name: Cold Room
